name: @intellectual-frontiers/anyfs-githost
description: The Git host backend of AnyFS: a branch of a repository on GitHub or GitLab kept as a store through the host's REST API, with a revision on every read, a stated expectation on every write and a batch that is one commit.

scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun ../tools/mizan-check.ts --root spec-kit && bun ../libraries/src/check.ts --root spec-kit --level L1 && bun ../kanon/src/check.ts && bun tools/check.ts && bun test suite/ && bun tools/pack.ts --check
